basis.quote: 须注意感情与物欲的区别

rules.text: 你的命宮有空劫，感情又重於物欲：能把桃花化為藝術，或者投入消費、娛樂一類的事業。
rules.en: Your Life Palace holds Kong or Jie, and feeling outweighs material desire: you can turn romance into art, or into work in consumer goods and entertainment.

rules.text: 你的命宮有空劫，物欲又重於感情：反而容易追求刺激。
rules.en: Your Life Palace holds Kong or Jie, and material desire outweighs feeling: it can push you to chase thrills instead.
